description: A hold record is a holding pattern at a fix. An author writes the hold for an air traffic control (ATC) holding stack, or a published holding leg of a procedure gives it.

$schema.description: This field identifies the schema that validates this document.

extensions.description: This field contains extension data in groups. The namespace of each group identifies the application or standard that supplies its data. The group `sim` contains the simulator data of the record.

hold.description: This field gives the holding pattern of this record. It has the same definition as the holding legs of a procedure.

id.description: This field identifies this record of a hold. Other resources and orders use this stable identifier to refer to this record of a hold.

kind.description: The value identifies this record as a record of a hold. The value selects this navigation contract.

name.description: This field gives the name of this record of a hold, for display.

provenance.description: This field gives the provenance of this record of a hold as structured data: how the data were made, the authority, the aeronautical information regulation and control (AIRAC) cycle and the tool that made them.

resources_ref.description: This field identifies the resource catalogue that resolves the references of this record of a hold. The reference gives the identifier and the revision of the catalogue.

source.description: This field gives the source of this record. The value gives the authority that publishes the data, and the cycle, for example `FAA CIFP cycle 2610`. A record that an author writes does not have this field. The field `provenance` gives the same facts as structured data.

title: Holding
